verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same. In each, the crowd illustration that carried the original has shrunk to a thin strip of tiny figures, so the key image is lost. The quote is broken into 12 short lines with awkward breaks ('INDEED,' left alone on its own line, a ragged right edge). 'THOUGHTFUL' and 'CHANGE' run almost to the right edge, and empty space is left at the bottom. A also floats its crowd strip under an odd top gap, which makes it look like a pasted thumbnail. B runs its crowd strip off the top edge the way the original does, so it is slightly closer to the original, but its strip is just as small.
